regions.region: title, abstract, introduction, and opening Results and Discussion
regions.finding: The title and abstract state the fluorohydroxylation scope; prior fluorination examples and the cited preparation method are contextual or prior literature and were not converted into new experiments.

regions.region: lower-right Table 1, reaction arrow, rows 1–15, and footnote a
regions.finding: Fifteen independent allenyl-phosphine-oxide preparation rows were extracted. Shared Ph2PCl/pyridine/CH2Cl2-Et2O/0 °C-to-room-temperature conditions were applied per row, while entry 7 retains the −40 °C footnote override.

unresolved: Table 1 structures were retained as source labels/names with SMILES unset and unverified.
The cited prior procedure is not part of the supplied evidence; details absent from this paper remain missing.

regions.region: left column prose and Table 2, rows 1–8 with footnotes a–e
regions.finding: Eight solvent/temperature fluorohydroxylation optimization rows were extracted separately, including NMR yields, E-2a/E-3a ratios, isolated yields in parentheses, commercial-MeCN and anhydrous-MeCN/7-equiv-water overrides.

regions.region: upper-right Table 3, rows 1–10 and conditions A/B footnote
regions.finding: Ten substrate-scope batches were extracted independently. A and B retain their distinct scales, solvent treatment, water loading, and nitrogen atmosphere, so rows matching Table 2 product labels were not collapsed.

regions.region: middle-right Table 4, rows 1–9 and footnotes a–e
regions.finding: Nine solvent, Selectfluor-loading, and temperature screening rows were extracted with NMR yield basis and the entry-7 isolated yield retained separately.
The ORTEP image supports the reported E-2f regio/stereochemical assignment but is not a separate reaction experiment.

unresolved: Individual component volumes for mixed-solvent Table 2 and Table 4 rows are not given.
Figure 1 does not by itself certify the machine-entered molecular representation; SMILES remain unset.

regions.region: left-column Table 5, rows 1–9 and footnotes a–e
regions.finding: Nine aryl-substituent scope experiments were extracted, including the 2.5- and 2.0-equivalent Selectfluor overrides, the 40 °C override, and chromatography/recrystallization notes.

regions.region: upper-right Table 6, rows 1–5 and footnotes a–e
regions.finding: Five Selectfluor-loading experiments were extracted separately with combined NMR yields, E-2o/E-4o ratios, room-temperature override, and parenthesized isolated yields.
The E-2o-to-E-4o fluorination using 2.2 equivalents Selectfluor was extracted as a separate reported experiment rather than merged with Table 6.
Figure 2 is structural support rather than a new batch. Scheme 1 was classified as a proposed mechanism with generic R groups, not as a reported experiment.

unresolved: Detailed recrystallization information referenced in Supplementary data was not supplied and was not inferred.
Generic mechanism structures cannot be expanded into fully specified molecules.

regions.region: left column Typical procedure I and sections 4.1.1–4.1.3
regions.finding: Exact quantities, staged temperature/time, workup, purification, product masses, and yields were merged into Table 1 records for 1a, 1b, and 1d; abbreviated preparations inherit only the explicitly stated Typical-procedure reference.

Exact starting quantities and product masses/yields were merged into Table 1 records for 1e, 1h, 1i, and the opening portion of 1j; analytical characterization was not treated as additional experiments.

unresolved: Most abbreviated preparations do not restate a reaction duration; these values remain null/missing.
Section 4.1.7 continues onto page 5 and was joined using evidence from both pages.

regions.region: left column continuation of 4.1.7 and sections 4.1.8–4.1.10
regions.finding: Exact quantities and product masses/yields for 1j–1m were merged into their Table 1 records; characterization text was retained as context but not duplicated as experiments.
Preparations of 1n, 1o, and 1g were merged into Table 1 rows; the −40 °C, 20 min addition and 11 h hold for 1g were preserved as structured conditions.
The starting quantities for the commercial-MeCN E-2a batch were joined to Table 2 entry 7; the procedure and outcome continue on page 6.

unresolved: Abbreviated Typical-procedure preparations omit reaction durations except where expressly stated.
The E-2a commercial-MeCN procedure crosses the page boundary and requires page 6 for completion.

regions.finding: Full workups and isolated product masses were merged into Table 2 entries 7, 8, and 1. The 10:1 MeCN/water batch retains separate isolated E-2a and E-3a yields in addition to the table NMR result.
Exact batch masses, solvent/water quantities, times, product masses, and isolated yields were merged into Table 3 entries 3–9 for E-2b through E-2e under conditions A/B.

unresolved: Section 4.2.6.2 continues on page 7, outside the claimed coverage range; Table 3 entry 10 remains table-supported only.
Analytical characterization was not transformed into additional reaction records.
